Agent Name: Planner

Step Number: 5

Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly normalized the date format from DD/MM/YYYY (11 September 1962) to MM/DD/YYYY (November 9, 1962). This led to confusion and inconsistency because the international standard for representing dates, especially in the contexts of European or Swedish sources, uses the DD/MM/YYYY format, whereas the Planner misinterpreted it as needing conversion to MM/DD/YYYY without proper context. This subsequently resulted in further unnecessary steps to correct and verify the already accurate data.
